The generic harness validator therefore rejected them before the procedure guard; this was not a procedure safety-rule refusal. The later guard refusal and acceptance in t-2026-09-24-0019 show that a schema-valid call could pass the harness boundary, so the recurring defect was malformed model output rather than an unavailable capability.
